'''Quan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] of a unknown [[Species/Legends|species]] who was a former associate of [[Gault Rennow|Tyresius Lokai]], having participated in the breaking of the [[Blockade of the Hydian Way]] with Lokai and [[Hylo Visz]]. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, Lokai&mdash;in his new identity as Gault Rennow&mdash;tracked down a now-retired Quan in his efforts to locate Visz. Rennow bought Quan a drink and questioned the man on Visz's whereabouts, but ended up [[Death/Legends|killing]] Quan, though he learned that Visz was hidden away on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="GaultConv" />
